Pepsi Pork Chops Or Chicken
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 17, 2009 - 11:11pm

Ingredients




12 fresh pork chops or chicken pieces
1/2 cup plain flour
1 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon pepper
1/4 cup oil for frying
12 ounces Pepsi
12 ounces catsup

Preparation

1 Salt and pepper meat and dredge in flour. Fry in oil on medium heat until brown. Place meat in 2 quart casserole. Mix Pepsi and catsup and pour over meat. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.
